setup: Settings file said model_policy_tier=open_weight at start (old value). Set to open_source_only through the plugin's own Filters panel in Browse models (no SSH edit). Filters turned off Essentials only and on Also-try-open-weight only to reach gemma3:1b (open_weight, 0.8 GB), selected it, then switched back to Open source only; queue kept 1 selected.
pressed: Pull selected (1) 0.8 GB, A; then A on the ring.

seen.box: Enable Tier 2 before pulling? (queue includes gemma3:1b)
seen.after_A: box closed; ollama list still 2 models (nomic-embed-text, gemma4:e2b-it-qat), no gemma3:1b, ollama ps no pull; settings file model_policy_tier still open_source_only

restore: Policy put back to open_weight through Filters + Done; settings file diff against pre-run snapshot is empty (identical).
note: Settings file only wrote the new policy some time after the change; Filters UI can show a stale value after a Cancel.
